scope: 2 newly recognized components, 2 fully supported cards. Prior supported programs and metadata unchanged.
source: Rainier English card text included verbatim per component; conversion input matched by stable card ID.

ruleReferences.usedFor: Official Morpeko Select a Snack: discard top three of own deck, choose one of those, show opponent, add to hand.
Resolve effect text in order; with an insufficient zone execute the possible portion of an effect. A discard recovery window cannot include previously discarded cards.

evidence.name: Select a Snack
evidence.textEn: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand.
evidence.textZh: 将自己牌库上方3张卡牌放于弃牌区，选择其中1张卡牌，在给对手看过之后加入手牌。
